

```{r}
MapWeather <- function(weather_data,crash_data, day){
  day_weather <- weather_data |> filter(date == day)
  coordinates(day_weather)<-~longitude+latitude
  
  day_crash <- crash_data |> filter(date==day)
  
  options(tigris_class = "sf")
  montgomery <- counties(state = "24", cb = TRUE, year = 2022) |>
  filter(NAME == "Montgomery")
  
  grd <- expand.grid(
  x = seq(-77.9, -76.9, by = 0.003),
  y = seq(38.8, 39.5, by = 0.003)  
  )
  coordinates(grd) <- ~x + y
  gridded(grd) <- TRUE
  
  variogram_model <- variogram(totalprcp ~ 1, data = day_weather)
  fitted_model <- fit.variogram(variogram_model, model = vgm("Sph"))
  
  
  kriging_result <- krige(totalprcp ~ 1, locations = day_weather, newdata = grd, model = fitted_model)

  kriging_raster <- raster(kriging_result)
  
  crs(kriging_raster) <- "EPSG:4326"
  
  raster_mont <- mask(kriging_raster, montgomery)
  
  
  pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "Blues",  
  domain = values(raster_mont),    
  na.color = "transparent"
)

  m <- leaflet() |>
  setView(lng = -77.20, lat = 39.14, zoom =10) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addRasterImage(raster_mont, opacity = 0.7, project = TRUE, colors = pal)|>
  addCircles(data = day_crash,opacity = 0.9, color = "Black")
  
  setwd("~/Data205/Data-205-Capstone-Paul-Hanscom/analysis/images/maps")
  mapview::mapshot2(m, "temp.html")
  webshot2::webshot("temp.html", file = paste0(day, '.png'))
  
}
```


```{r}
MapWeather(Weather_Cleaned,Crash, "2025-01-13")
```
